uv_coverage_scope: Conservatively rasterized chart samples including edge band; original triangles/UVs unchanged.
native_fallback: Gaussian DC original atlas retained where no unmasked first-hit photograph supports surface
selection: highest cosine²*lens_confidence²/(0.16+distance²), one photographic winner per texel; two-pass color/temporal consensus unless diagnostic single-pass requested
temporal_support_scope: At least min_time_groups distinct3-second bins with photos individually matching consensus color; geometry/poses still in-sample.
validation_scope: Excluded source photos are held out from texturing only. Geometry/poses were trained using them; this is not a held-out reconstruction test.
seam_metric_scope: Neighboring supported atlas texels with world-position separation<=0.03 approximate meters; not a complete welded UV-chart seam analysis.
coordinate_frame: unchanged normalized COLMAP/mesh frame; four-term calibrated OPENCV_FISHEYE; image top-left storage
limitations: Photography cannot repair geometric surface errors.
Masked/occluded/unseen surfaces keep original native texture; supported coverage is not geometric validation.
Best-view seams can remain because source exposure or reconstructed surfaces differ.
